title: Denver Street Art, Murals & Graffiti Tour + Brewery Visit
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
NEW to Viator, but longtime Denver favorite!
Come join us & jump into exploring Denver's hip, fun, trendy RiNo Art District the best way possible: on foot! See & experience Denver's most unique street art in our Mile High City's most happening & eclectic neighborhood. You'll hear the behind-the-art stories of the murals (& the diverse artists that created it) that even many locals don't know.

Kick things off at the must-visit Denver Central Market & then hit the streets & alleyways for our graffiti adventure, exploring Denver's mural-filled streets & ducking into all of the activated, art-filled alleyways. If you're the type that likes a little bit of everything: art, culture, & great stories that make The Mile High City come alive; this tour's for you.

The other best parts? We'll stop at a local brewery for a beer tasting (3 x 4 oz. pours or a non-alcoholic beverage of your choice; included in your ticket price!) and you'll have a ton of opportunities to take some amazing pics!
